title: Getting Started with Azure Cosmos DB
body:
Posted on January 15, 2025 by Admin

What is Cosmos DB?

Azure Cosmos DB is a globally distributed, multi-model database service designed for mission-critical applications. It offers turnkey global distribution, elastic scaling, and comprehensive SLAs.

Key Features

  • Global distribution with multi-master replication
  • Elastic scaling of throughput and storage
  • Multiple data models (document, key-value, graph, column-family)
  • Multiple consistency levels
  • 99.999% availability SLA

Getting Started

// Connect to Cosmos DB
const { CosmosClient } = require('@azure/cosmos');

const client = new CosmosClient({
  endpoint: process.env.COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT,
  key: process.env.COSMOS_DB_KEY
});

const database = client.database('blog');
const container = database.container('posts');

Learn more at Azure Cosmos DB Documentation.
author: Admin

Performance Best Practices

When building 3D web applications with React Three Fiber, performance is crucial. Here are key optimization techniques.

Memory Management

  • Dispose of geometries and materials when unmounting
  • Use object pooling for frequently created/destroyed objects
  • Implement LOD (Level of Detail) systems
  • Monitor memory usage with performance tools

title: Modern Go Web Development with Gin
body:
Posted on January 25, 2025 by Sarah Johnson

Why Go for Web Development?

Go (Golang) has become increasingly popular for web development due to its simplicity, performance, and strong concurrency support.

Setting Up Gin Framework

package main

import (
    "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    r := gin.Default()
    
    // Middleware
    r.Use(gin.Logger())
    r.Use(gin.Recovery())
    
    // Routes
    r.GET("/", func(c *gin.Context) {
        c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
            "message": "Hello, World!",
        })
    })
    
    r.Run(":8080")
}

Best Practices

  • Use middleware for cross-cutting concerns
  • Implement proper error handling
  • Structure your application with clean architecture
  • Use dependency injection for testability
  • Implement proper logging and monitoring

Learn more about Gin framework.
